subject: 2026-10-18-schwab-blocks-outside-ai-agents
text:
Brief says: "Charles Schwab says it is blocking outside AI agents from accessing client accounts and is directing clients to its own assistant, Charley."
Source says: "Instead, Schwab is directing clients to its own fledgling AI assistant, Charley, while also allowing them to use ChatGPT and other large language models for stock trades and other transactions." and "Schwab is specifically preventing AI agents from using clients' login credentials or browser automation to access its systems." (https://www.americanbanker.com/news/schwab-blocks-unauthorized-ai-agents-points-clients-to-charley)
Suggested fix: "Charles Schwab says it is blocking outside AI agents that log in with client credentials or browser automation, and is directing clients to its own assistant, Charley, while still letting them use ChatGPT and other large language models for trades." The headline can stay. While there, fix the tense in "On October 15, Charles Schwab says" (e.g. "Charles Schwab said on October 15 that..."). (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc; both quotes confirmed on the page with source.mjs.)
